marketing_description: The DeWALT DCLE34031B 3x360 Line Laser features 3x360° self-levelling lines, providing a reliable solution for various applications. This cordless tool offers up to 11 hours of operation and includes features such as drop protection, water resistance, and last mode memory for quick start up. With a working range of up to 330 ft with a detector, this laser level is suitable for a range of tasks.
